about: The fixture claims the corpus world writes pages from, and the 20 fixture queries run over them (#355 AC1, AC3, AC7, Proof). Each `you` claim's text is said, word for word, by you in a session of repo api and in a session of repo web, so it is learned at install at scope all with two agreeing sources. The others are listed under `special` and built by pages.test.ts, which fills in the message, decision and repo handles.

you.text: The api service reads its settings from config/api.toml
The api test suite runs with npm test in the api folder
Api migrations live in db/migrations and run before deploys
The api health route answers on /healthz
The web app builds with vite into the dist folder
Web previews deploy from every pull request
The web app reads the api base address from VITE_API_URL
Web lint runs eslint with the shared config
The web test suite runs with npm test and playwright
Both repos pin Node 24.22 in their engines field
Local databases run in docker compose on the laptop
Secrets for local runs live in the macOS keychain
The shared deploy script lives in scripts/deploy.sh
You review pull requests in the morning before standups
You prefer small commits with one change each
You keep release notes in CHANGELOG.md

procfile.note: a repo file at a commit (Procfile in the trusted api repo), scope repo:api

decision.text: Deploys wait for a green run on main
decision.answer: Deploys wait for a green run on main; hotfixes still need a review

link.text: The api setup guide is at {link}
link.note: said by you once, in a session of api: scope repo:api; {link} is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/setup?token=opensesame&from=wiki on the test's counting server

proof3.text: Both repos format code with prettier on save
proof3.note: said by you in a session of api and in two sessions of web: three agreeing sources (the api message cited twice counts once)

proof1.text: The api error codes are listed in docs/errors.md
proof1.note: said by you once, in a session of api: one source, scope repo:api
